```figdown
# FigDown — figures as text. Spec: https://github.com/FigDown/figdown
figdown 0.1 topology
title "Branch office WAN uplinks"

class backup "Diverse-path backup WAN link" style=dashed

node access1 "Access Switch 1"
node access2 "Access Switch 2"
node branch "Branch Router"
node hubprimary "Regional Hub Router (Primary)"
node hubbackup "Regional Hub Router (Backup)"

link access1 -- branch
link access2 -- branch
link branch -[primary WAN]-- hubprimary
link branch -[backup WAN]-- hubbackup class=backup
```

Note: the previous attempt's four errors were all on the edge lines — `topology` rejects a bare `a -- b` edge statement (the form that works in `block`). I could not load `reference/experimental/topology.md` in this session to confirm the genre's own edge keyword, so I've made the smallest structural change consistent with the error message: prefixing each edge with `link`, keeping the bracketed inline-label form and the trailing `class=` from the working `block`-style syntax, since those were not flagged as errors. If `link` is not in fact the topology genre's correct keyword, rerun `build-svg.js` and treat any new error as authoritative over this guess — I have not been able to validate this revision myself.
